question: Related Questions Q. UMRAH IN LAST 10 DAYS OF RAMADHAN 2250 views Q. I reside in Riyadh and would like to go for umra. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 32206 Country: Pakistan Title: If a woman has jewelery whose price is huge. such that she and her husband can go to perform hajj after selling it. Question: If a woman has jewelery whose price is huge. such that she and her husband can go to perform hajj after selling it. Is hajj farz on her? Answer ID: 32206 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 854/L=318/TL=1432) Hajj shall be fardh on a woman who owns jewelleries that if sold can suffice the expenses of husband and wife for performing hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
